flashcard_questions.q: Reproduction involving the fusion of male and female gametes, producing offspring that are genetically different from each parent.
Reproduction involving only one parent, with no fusion of gametes — offspring are genetically identical clones of the parent.
Sex cells used in reproduction — sperm and egg cells in animals, pollen and egg cells in plants. Each contains half the normal number of chromosomes.

flashcard_questions.a: The fusion of a male and female gamete to form a zygote, restoring the full chromosome number.
Differences between individuals of the same species, caused by genetic differences, environmental factors, or both.
